issues.title: Crossbow in offhand hides spear
issues.body: Hello and good day, I have discovered a _potential_ issue in this mod while holding the crossbow in the offhand. I have attached details so that the relevant parties may investigate at their convenience. Minecraft version: 26.2 Fabric API version: 0.154.0+26.2 NotEnoughAnimations version : 1.12.4 When holding a charged crossbow in the offhand, because all items in the main hand are hidden, when the player is holding a spear it becomes entirely invisible despite consuming left and right click functionality. This is of course likely due to the feature advertised as "Don't show items during two-handed animations". This does apply to other weapons, but the solution is not as clear in those cases since the vanilla behavior there is the overlap issue the mentioned feature of this mod addresses. For that reason I kept the issue specific to the spear. Maybe there could be an exception for the spear item in this case, or perhaps configuration for this feature of the mod? I defer to the judgement of the relevant parties. Thank you in general for the mod, and for considering this issue. Minimal modded instance Vanilla

issues.title: Animations bug with FA Player Extension
issues.body:
For some reason, if you use Not Enough Animations and FA Player Extension at the same time, then when using the Scorcher or Soul Scorcher from the Dungeon Now Loading mod, when viewed from a third person and turning the camera from side to side, the animation is performed incorrectly, and the character simply lowers his hands when using this weapon.
If you disable Player Extension or NotEnoughAnimations, this bug disappears.
I'm not sure who exactly I should report the bug to in this case, but I decided to report it to you.
I know that at the moment FA Player Extension and NEA are not compatible yet, but since the bug relates to animations of another mod, I decided to report it anyway.
Forge 1.20.1, EMF 3.2.2, NEA 1.12.2

issues.title: 26.1.1 port
issues.body: Minecraft just released the 26.1.1 days ago and I was wondering if you can port your mods to that said version

issues.title: [Feature request] Crossbows don't have any animation while crawling
issues.body: I'm using Fabric 1.19.4, and in v1.12.0 of Not Enough Animations, the swim animation plays when I should be crawling (I am on land)

issues.title: The mod isn't compatible with Punchy! - First Person Animation Mod
issues.body: When I use Punchy! the third person perspective become normal and Not Enough Animation's animations were deleted :(

issues.title: Needing another mod to use NEA.
issues.body: I just updated the mod 1.12.0, and it won't let me start my Minecraft without having a mod installed called "ichor 0.0.0". I tried searching it up online and it just shows me some mod pack. I tried to reinstall it and put it back in my mod folder, but it gives me the same error.

issues.title: support for freeze frame camera mod
issues.body: this is specifically in regards to holding the picture you have just taken third person: first person: it would be nice to be able to have this, even if its really small. thank you!

issues.title: spinny hand when swimming
issues.body: Whenever the player is in motion in the swimming state and punches (or sometimes for no reason in the first couple of seconds after entering said state), the player's hand spins around and glitches about before returning to the swimming animation. It looks like maybe some sort of interpolation artifact between the end of the punch animation and trying to sync back up with the ongoing swimming animation?

issues.title: Burning and freezing animation takes priority over attack animation
issues.body:
While burning or freezing with the mod active, the attack animation is barely visible. The arm seems to move a few millimeters but its mostly locked into the burning or freezing animation.

Bow, crossbow and shield work fine it's just punching or sword swinging.

Tested on 1.21.1

issues.title: (Not an Issue) Question on how you make the player animations
issues.body:
Hi, this actually isn't an issue but I was curious how you made the player animations for the mod, if there were any tools you used or not.

I was trying to make my own mod of climbing up blocks and playing an animation that pairs with it, but I haven't found any good resources for animating the player other than hand coding it. I have taken a look at the source code for yours as well as Minecraft's, and I cannot tell if you are referencing something, created an animation in another software and used a script to export it to code, or you do trial and error to make the animation look good. 

Thanks for your time!

issues.title: New lantern holding animations don't work with the copper lantern (1.21.11 Fabric)
issues.body: The animation works with the regular and soul lantern, but not the copper lantern or its different oxidized states versions.

issues.title: Using Smithing Table crashes game
issues.body: Whenever I tried to open the smithing table, my game would crash. I took out NEA and it started working again. I think this is a problem with the mod.

issues.title: NEA showing in mod menu but not working
issues.body: I use fabric Lunar Client 1.21, and recently NEA has stopped working entirely. It had previously worked fine and I was able to access the config screen from the mod menu, but now there is no option for any config screen nor do the animations work at all. I ruled out a possible mod conflict by using only the necessary mods for NEA to function, but still nothing happened. I assume this happened due to the updating or changing of some mod or even lunar client itself, but I still don't know why this really happened. I also tried in 1.21.8 with no success. Does anyone have any solutions?

issues.title: Hold Up camera offset bug
issues.body:
sometimes the hold up camerta offset gets reset to its original 0.1 value, when in the config it's supposed to be another value, it gets fixed by going to third person

edit: found new info, usinf First person model mod I found out that it gets reset by looking down and then turning left.  Happens using smooth rotation lock

issues.title: Missing optical adjustment options + A bug
issues.body: Hello! (Minecraft 1.21.8 / Fabric 1.1.0) - (First Person v2.5.0 / NotEnoughAnimations v1.10.2) Based on the following pictures, I would like to ask, if you could add some additional options to the mod. And an animation for the arms while fishing. If you need a full list of all the mods and resource packs I have installed, I will gladly provide. 1) Fishing As you can see, the fishing line is disconnected from the fishing rod. It's even worse, if the fishing rod is marked as an held up item. Could you make it so that the end point of the line follows the end of the fishing rod? For the arm animation to hold the fishing rod, I was imagining to reuse the main-offhand swap animation, and hold it when the hands touch. 2) Riding A Horse My view is pretty blocked by the items I hold. I would like an option to blend out the held items while riding, if they aren't used. Maybe with an adjustable cooldown before the items are blended out again after using them. 3) Individual held item rotation settings needed. The lantern (Better Lanterns v1.2) is in my case held like a flashlight. I would like to rotate it down. But without also effecting other held up items, to not mess those up in consequence. 4) BUG: It looks like a slider is not working. :( In this picture I want to show which items are selected to be held up and that all settings are on default. (Torches Reimagined v1.5) In this picture I moved the holding arm position to y(-0.5). But there is no difference to y(0). No change for holding arm position y(+0.4). But the holding arm x-adjustments work! If the y-slider is supposed to do something else, I couldn't see what had changed. To point 3 again, the flames of the torch are clipping through my head. But it can't be rotated as much as the lantern requires, without going to look weird, if all held items share the same rotation value.

issues.title: Update the mod's License link on Modrinth page
issues.body:
Heyya! I noticed that the license link on the Modrinth page of **Not Enough Animations** points to the `1.18` branch, which hasn’t been active for about 5 years.

Would it be possible to update the link so it points to the license file on the default (`main`) branch instead?
That way the link always reflects the up-to-date version of the project.

Thanks!

issues.title: Crossbow animation has no maximum vertical angle
issues.body:
To clarify I am using minecraft version 1.19.2 with the forge modloader

The first person mod being used is:
[First-person Model (Forge/Fabric) by tr7zw](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/first-person-model)

The normal bow animation is locked and doesn't go up past a certain point preventing the arms and bow from blocking the player's view in firstperson.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fcf839eb-9873-4d88-ba87-0153d511163a)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cf486b4c-62c0-478b-818f-2c7f9f79e540)

(Still some view blocking on the firing animation when looking straight up but it's an acceptable amount.)

**The crossbow animation has no such limit on it.**

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/16711cde-a426-4e30-81e1-54be04d5ff5a)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3e730a63-61a9-4914-81f0-cf8cc543730f)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/127a26a5-eb00-4f8a-ab96-5245269dbdf9)

Here's what the first person view looks like

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/89fee249-655b-4fac-995f-8eb8b54440ad)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/77ad4e8d-73a7-420a-bc17-0c9d1cbc8ff9)

This could be fixed by limiting the crossbow animation the same way the bow animation is limited.

Another "fix" could involve adding an option for the crossbow aiming to be one handed and only the reload being two handed. This would make it clearer where the player is aiming and if the crossbow is in offhand with a primary weapon allows for other players what they are working with/against.

issues.body:
Hi all

I'm using 1.6.2 for 1.19.2 in Valhelsia 5 and having rendering issues with the secondary color/layer of the pneumatic armor from pneumatic craft.

The armor has customizable color for base color, and an accent color. With not enough animations, the accent layer gets "doubled" where one layer always renders with the original white color, and another layer that is rendered with the custom color, and is animated differently, causing visual glitches.

As you can see in the poorly taken screenshot (with accent color set to white so they render with same color), it's mostly visible when in horizontal position, and also mostly visible on the chest piece but applies to all armor pieces.

Happy to test any fixes for you.

issues.title: Client-sideness is not explictitly stated
issues.body:
## Problem
Hi there. I revamped my modpack, which uses Not Enough Animations, and I hadn't noticed that it only works as client-side mod until my server refused to startup and I started researching the issue. Conversations, such as #63 explained why, but I was surprised that the "client-sideness" is not explicitly stated on the CurseForge Description page, nor the README on this repo. I was even a little mislead when I read that this mod is "fully vanilla/3rd party server compatible."

## Suggestion
I suggest that you make an explicit statement on the above pages that Not Enough Animations is _not_ a server-side mod and/or is only designed to run on a client.

issues.title: ( Suggestion ) New rotation locking
issues.body:
It is very surprising that unlike vanilla, 
only the upper body can move independently when rotating the body. 
This creates an environment that is more realistic and immersive in your character.

But it comes with discomfort when holding something in your hand. 
That's especially true when the object is large and covers a larger area of the screen.
For example, when holding a shield and a weapon at the same time.
There is no problem when you stand still and face the front.
But as you move to dodge or attack enemies, 
your shield and sword will often come to the center of the screen and block your view, 
and it becomes causing motion sickness.

You'll have to rotate the screen almost 90 degrees 
to get the shield and sword back into place so they don't block the front. 
Or, you have to walk straight ahead 
without using the left or right buttons at the same time as moving forward. 
This is impossible in the case of complicated moving such as battle.

So this mod has a config option called rotation locking. 
But it just locks the upper body movement like vanilla.

That offsets the benefits of this mod.
So I propose a new rotation locking.
It is to make the locking smooth, 
like the smoothing animation feature.
If you move the camera left or right, 
the upper body follows like a spring.
And it's even better if it comes with a feature that allows you to adjust the strength, 
like a smoothing animation amount feature.

It was inspired by Taekwondo-like moves.
Taekwondo players quickly turn their heads to fix their eyes on the opponent first, 
and then the body rotates along the head to hit the enemy with a kick.

This will definitely reduce 3D motion sickness, 
and at the same time, the independent upper body rotation function, 
which is unique to this mod, can coexist.

issues.title: Fix player model positioning when sneaking and crawling
issues.body:
As per #68 this may be out of scope, but it's probably worth bringing this up anyway as the mod does intend to fix many of the problems with player models.

Currently, the player model is positioned incorrectly in certain poses, which is undesirable.

Normal standing: working exactly as expected and included here for comparison's sake
![2022-02-28_16 23 42](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52297970/156020561-97607f3c-184a-4426-a87a-3c969c5aebd5.png)

Sneaking: player is slightly offset into the ground (https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-48191)
![2022-02-28_16 23 45](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52297970/156020629-e12eab74-0546-471e-86c1-d333da9d6a97.png)

Crawling: player levitates slightly above the ground (https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-202579)
![2022-02-28_16 24 02](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52297970/156020700-f59c1468-b329-4d9e-bab6-1486773cb2cd.png)

Fix should be relatively simple: for sneaking, the player model should be moved upwards by a couple of pixels or so such that their feet don't intersect the ground, but are instead flush with it like with standing (this may also fix https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-142684), and for crawling the player model should be moved downwards such that their torso makes direct contact with the block below.

issues.title: "Punching" animation while crawling snaps back immediately instead of smoothly
issues.body:
Usually when standing or sneaking, the punch/item use animation results in the arm smoothly reverting to its default position. This doesn't seem to happen when crawling (yet to test if this is a vanilla issue or a problem with the crawling animation the mod adds), in which the arm immediately shifts back to its default position rather than smoothly going back.
![crawlinganim-discontinuity](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52297970/156018414-8e93a2d6-35ec-4ea7-8a6a-f4bdd42b1a11.gif)

issues.title: Animations for using tridents/bows/crossbows in the left hand while crawling are incorrect, differ from right hand
issues.body:
While using it in the right hand seems to work fine, using it in the left hand seems to highlight multiple problems:
- The right hand immediately snaps to the player's side as if they were standing.
- The left hand appears to be completely stiff and doesn't use the expected aiming animation.

![2022-02-28_16 06 11](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52297970/156017063-6530c27f-3f2b-412a-84ec-f2ce49254b6e.png)

Bows and crossbows appear to problems when crawling as well, as the left hand and right hand use animations also differ.

issues.title: Smoother animation for entering/exiting beds
issues.body:
Another one like #52 and #69, of course concerning beds. Even with smooth animations turned on, this too has an abrupt change where a more smooth transition would be expected. How exactly we'd pull this off I'm not sure, but something should be possible.
![2022-02-28_15 58 02](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52297970/156015828-02058a22-a3ed-4978-b484-a7778cbcd18b.png)
![2022-02-28_15 58 03](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52297970/156015831-9f99467b-9849-4be8-a48f-e6199b0f1bc1.png)
![2022-02-28_15 58 06](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52297970/156015832-a2a6f423-3f34-490e-9b03-dc8b2d555ae6.png)

Also of note is that when exiting a bed, the player's arm swings as if an item were used, which doesn't make sense. If an animation is added for exiting the bed, perhaps this arm animation could be removed?

One last thing to note (which isn't exactly player model related, but probably still relevant) is that Bedrock Edition has an exclusive animation for the first-person camera when in bed, which moves it downwards as it fades. It may be possible to port this (perhaps as a separate mod), but another thing that could be done would be to have the player's head also animate in much the same way when in bed for a sufficiently long period of time.

issues.body: I found by accident that when you use /clear or shift click the delete item button to clear your inventory after having just equipped a sword, it gets stuck in the scabbard position even if you no longer have the weapon in your inventory

issues.title: 1.4.0 incompatible with Essential

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

issues.body: When using 1.4.0, all entities are invisible and the [Essential](https://essential.gg/) stuff is broken (buttons and stuff).

issues.title: [Suggestion] Show player arms holding items in first person
issues.body:
Always struck me as odd that you couldn't see your hands holding items in first person. Could also come with actual slashing animations for swords and more.
+Resource pack support?

issues.title: Cool idea - add sneaking animation
issues.body: Awesome would be to see crouching animation: switching from standing to sneaking, not instant, but smoothly animated switching. 🏆 I'm talking about 3rd person

issues.title: [Bug] Having an item in your offhand with your fist in your main hand freeze's your arms on the paper doll.
issues.body: Similar to the previous issue where your arms were frozen on paperdoll, Your main hand will freeze if you have an item in your offhand but it unfreezes only if you go in third person. Otherwise, going back to first person, it freezes.

issues.title: [Bug] using /lay makes your arms frozen
issues.body: So I play on a server that has the GSit plugin and I noticed when I /lay, when I have an item in both my hands, It doesnt show the item that I'm holding while laying there and my arms are frozen when I want to punch and it jiggles my torso just like it used to do for the paper doll.

issues.title: [Bug] Item holding has prio over bow offhand animation
[New animation] Item swapping
issues.body:
The idea would be that when you swap an item from/to the offhand using the swap button (usually F), that the character would move their arms together, to indicate a quick movement of items.

I hope you can imagine what I mean, because currently is that swapping without any visual indicator a bit bad...
